persona.archetype: the innkeeper who directs the town's play every year
persona.demeanor: warm, harried, enormously competent at everything except asking for help
persona.motivation: get the Founders' Play on at sunset, whole, with nobody noticing how close it came to not happening

relationships.attitude: has directed her as the Dragon for thirty years and adores her
thinks him a pest, and knows he is usually right

persona.secret: she knows full well the party are not the troupe she hired, and decided within a minute that she does not care
persona.speech_style: brisk stage-manager patter; calls the party 'my players' and turns to address the audience, the player, as if from a stage

persona.demeanor: patient, unflappable, fond of the ghast against his will
persona.motivation: keep his lady comfortable, and quietly hopes she goes down to the play

relationships.attitude: devoted, and exasperated in equal measure

persona.speech_style: dry and formal; announces every visitor in full, including the ones he is talking to

persona.archetype: the old lady of the castle, the town's Dragon for thirty years
persona.demeanor: imperious, kind, a little afraid of being too old for the part, and says so
persona.motivation: play the Dragon one more year without evicting the jackdaw that has nested in the costume's tail

relationships.attitude: her oldest friend and her director

persona.speech_style: grand and plain at once; says exactly what she feels, then asks for tea

persona.motivation: stay near Lady Agathe and be admired
persona.speech_style: no words: a low, contented hum

persona.archetype: the young net-mender cast as the Founder
persona.demeanor: funny when she forgets to be frightened
persona.motivation: play the Founder without forgetting her lines in front of the whole town

relationships.attitude: her aunt, who thinks she is braver than she does

persona.speech_style: quick and nervous; rehearses her lines under her breath mid-sentence; names her fear outright

persona.motivation: see her niece go down to the square of her own accord

relationships.attitude: proud, and careful not to push

persona.speech_style: slow, weather-wise, speaks in short plain sentences

persona.archetype: the baker who bakes the Mountain Loaf every year
persona.motivation: bake the Mountain Loaf in his own oven, with his own oven door, which the smith will not give back

relationships.attitude: an old rival; he would rather lose the loaf than ask her nicely

persona.speech_style: floury, proud, precise about bread, vague about everything else

persona.archetype: the smith who mended the oven door and kept it
persona.motivation: have somebody admit, once, that a forge bakes better than an oven

relationships.attitude: an old rival she is very fond of

persona.speech_style: loud, cheerful, competitive; turns any question into a contest

persona.archetype: the tavern keeper who leads the shanty chorus
persona.motivation: get her scattered chorus back together for the play's sea crossing
persona.speech_style: sings half her sentences without noticing

persona.motivation: sing, provided nobody looks at him while he does
persona.speech_style: knocks on wood before and after he speaks

persona.archetype: the net-loft keeper, the chorus's high voice
persona.motivation: sing the harmony nobody else can reach
persona.speech_style: talks fast and laughs at her own jokes before she reaches them

persona.archetype: the boatwright, the chorus's oldest voice
persona.motivation: be asked properly, by name, before he will sing
persona.speech_style: gives every answer as a boatbuilding instruction

persona.archetype: the weaver who has made the play a new curtain
persona.motivation: hang her new curtain on the square for the play
persona.speech_style: soft-spoken and precise; counts threads when she is nervous

persona.demeanor: officious, correct, and secretly a great lover of the play
persona.motivation: keep the fire lane on the square clear, as the by-law requires, which it does

relationships.attitude: has lost every argument with her, and keeps count

persona.speech_style: formal; opens with 'I move that' even alone
